wholePhysicalScope: Named main-house placement and the 1974 HABS plan and three elevations; the 2008 Qualla original supplies surface colors.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the red hip roof, double portico, raised basement and both pairs of steps. Near levels add the recessed sash, column capitals, paving and ironwork.
limitations: The survey establishes the main-house dimensions, roof and stair arrangement. Cornice carving, ironwork and column capitals are simplified at this scale, and heights read from the survey scans are approximate.

The original elevation field is unchanged. Landing thresholds and small step adjustments follow the sampled grade. The house represents April 2008 and covers the standing main building and its two approaches.
